channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — Latest Movers
channel.description: Actively exploited vulnerabilities rising fastest in Cyber Threat Wall rankings.

item.title: CVE-2026-88772 — Citrix NetScaler
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution or denial of service

item.title: CVE-2026-88771 — Citrix NetScaler
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper input validation vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

item.title: CVE-2026-55040 — Microsoft SharePoint
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Microsoft SharePoint contains a weak authentication vulnerability which allows an unauthorized attacker to bypass a security feature over a network.

item.title: CVE-2026-63030 — WordPress Core
item.description: Threat Signal 66. WordPress Core contains an interpretation conflict vulnerability that could allow an attacker to perform SQL Injection and achieve Remote Code Execution. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-60137.

item.title: CVE-2025-67038 — Lantronix EDS5000
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Lantronix EDS5000 contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow attackers to inject arbitrary OS commands into the username parameter. Injected commands are executed with root privileges.

item.title: CVE-2026-33017 — Langflow Langflow
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Langflow contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow building public flows without requiring authentication.

item.title: CVE-2024-37079 — Broadcom VMware vCenter Server
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Broadcom VMware vCenter Server contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the implementation of the DCERPC protocol. This could allow a malicious actor with network access to vCenter Server to send specially crafted network packets, potentially leading to remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2016-7836 — SKYSEA Client View
item.description: Threat Signal 66. SKYSEA Client View contains an improper authentication vulnerability that allows remote code execution via a flaw in processing authentication on the TCP connection with the management console program.

item.title: CVE-2025-43300 — Apple iOS, iPadOS, and macOS
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Apple iOS, iPadOS, and macOS contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the Image I/O framework.

item.title: CVE-2014-3931 — Looking Glass Multi-Router Looking Glass (MRLG)
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Multi-Router Looking Glass (MRLG) contains a buffer overflow vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to cause an arbitrary memory write and memory corruption.

item.title: CVE-2023-33538 — TP-Link Multiple Routers
item.description: Threat Signal 66. TP-Link TL-WR940N V2/V4, TL-WR841N V8/V10, and TL-WR740N V1/V2 contain a command injection vulnerability via the component /userRpm/WlanNetworkRpm. The impacted products could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

item.title: CVE-2023-39780 — ASUS RT-AX55 Routers
item.description: Threat Signal 66. ASUS RT-AX55 devices contain an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow a remote, authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands. As represented by CVE-2023-41346.

item.title: CVE-2025-32756 — Fortinet Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Fortinet FortiFone, FortiVoice, FortiNDR and FortiMail contain a stack-based overflow vulnerability that may allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code or commands via crafted HTTP requests.

item.title: CVE-2024-11120 — GeoVision Multiple Devices
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Multiple GeoVision devices contain an OS command injection vulnerability that allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to inject and execute arbitrary system commands. The impacted products could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

item.title: CVE-2025-25181 — Advantive VeraCore
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Advantive VeraCore contains a SQL injection vulnerability in timeoutWarning.asp that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary SQL commands via the PmSess1 parameter.

item.title: CVE-2025-22225 — VMware ESXi
item.description: Threat Signal 66. VMware ESXi contains an arbitrary write vulnerability. Successful exploitation allows an attacker with privileges within the VMX process to trigger an arbitrary kernel write leading to an escape of the sandbox.

item.title: CVE-2024-9380 — Ivanti Cloud Services Appliance (CSA)
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Ivanti Cloud Services Appliance (CSA) contains an OS command injection vulnerability in the administrative console which can allow an authenticated attacker with application admin privileges to pass commands to the underlying OS.

item.title: CVE-2023-4762 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Google Chromium V8 contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute code via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2023-5631 — Roundcube Webmail
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Roundcube Webmail contains a persistent cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to run malicious JavaScript code.

item.title: CVE-2023-32434 — Apple Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Apple iOS. iPadOS, macOS, and watchOS contain an integer overflow vulnerability that could allow an application to execute code with kernel privileges.

item.title: CVE-2023-33009 — Zyxel Multiple Firewalls
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Zyxel ATP, USG FLEX, USG FLEX 50(W), USG20(W)-VPN, VPN, and ZyWALL/USG firewalls contain a buffer overflow vulnerability in the notification function that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to cause denial-of-service (DoS) conditions and remote code execution on an affected device.

item.title: CVE-2023-33010 — Zyxel Multiple Firewalls
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Zyxel ATP, USG FLEX, USG FLEX 50(W), USG20(W)-VPN, VPN, and ZyWALL/USG firewalls contain a buffer overflow vulnerability in the ID processing function that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to cause denial-of-service (DoS) conditions and remote code execution on an affected device.

item.title: CVE-2023-2033 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Google Chromium V8 Engine contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2022-41223 — Mitel MiVoice Connect
item.description: Threat Signal 66. The Director component in Mitel MiVoice Connect allows an authenticated attacker with internal network access to execute code within the context of the application.

item.title: CVE-2022-40765 — Mitel MiVoice Connect
item.description: Threat Signal 66. The Mitel Edge Gateway component of MiVoice Connect allows an authenticated attacker with internal network access to execute commands within the context of the system.

item.title: CVE-2023-21674 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Microsoft Windows Advanced Local Procedure Call (ALPC) contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2022-41073 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Microsoft Windows Print Spooler contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows an attacker to gain SYSTEM-level privileges.

item.title: CVE-2018-19322 — GIGABYTE Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 66. The GPCIDrv and GDrv low-level drivers in GIGABYTE App Center, AORUS Graphics Engine, XTREME Gaming Engine, and OC GURU II expose functionality to read/write data from/to IO ports. This could be leveraged in a number of ways to ultimately run code with elevated privileges.

item.title: CVE-2021-3493 — Linux Kernel
item.description: Threat Signal 66. The overlayfs stacking file system in Linux kernel does not properly validate the application of file capabilities against user namespaces, which could lead to privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2013-6282 — Linux Kernel
item.description: Threat Signal 66. The get_user and put_user API functions of the Linux kernel fail to validate the target address when being used on ARM v6k/v7 platforms. This allows an application to read and write kernel memory which could lead to privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2017-5030 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Google Chromium V8 Engine contains a memory corruption vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute code via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2008-0655 — Adobe Acrobat and Reader
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Adobe Acrobat and Reader contains an unespecified vulnerability described as a design flaw which could allow a specially crafted file to be printed silently an arbitrary number of times.

item.title: CVE-2015-1671 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 66. A remote code execution vulnerability exists when components of Windows, .NET Framework, Office, Lync, and Silverlight fail to properly handle TrueType fonts.

item.title: CVE-2020-0638 — Microsoft Update Notification Manager
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Microsoft Update Notification Manager contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2019-11707 — Mozilla Firefox and Thunderbird
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Mozilla Firefox and Thunderbird contain a type confusion vulnerability that can occur when manipulating JavaScript objects due to issues in Array.pop, allowing for an exploitable crash.

item.title: CVE-2019-1130 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 66. A privilege escalation vulnerability exists when Windows AppX Deployment Service (AppXSVC) improperly handles hard links.

item.title: CVE-2019-3568 — Meta Platforms WhatsApp
item.description: Threat Signal 66. A buffer overflow vulnerability in WhatsApp VOIP stack allowed remote code execution via specially crafted series of RTCP packets sent to a target phone number.

item.title: CVE-2021-27852 — Checkbox Checkbox Survey
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in CheckboxWeb.dll of Checkbox Survey allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code.

item.title: CVE-2014-0130 — Rails Ruby on Rails
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Directory traversal vulnerability in actionpack/lib/abstract_controller/base.rb in the implicit-render implementation in Ruby on Rails allows remote attackers to read arbitrary files via a crafted request.

item.title: CVE-2019-1129 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 66. A privilege escalation vulnerability exists when Windows AppXSVC improperly handles hard links. An attacker who successfully exploited this vulnerability could run processes in an elevated context.

item.title: CVE-2015-2424 — Microsoft PowerPoint
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Microsoft PowerPoint allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code or cause a denial of service (memory corruption) via a crafted Office document.

item.title: CVE-2014-0496 — Adobe Reader and Acrobat
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Adobe Reader and Acrobat contain a use-after-free vulnerability which can allow for code execution.

item.title: CVE-2014-4404 — Apple OS X
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Heap-based buffer overflow in IOHIDFamily in Apple OS X, which affects, iOS before 8 and Apple TV before 7, allows attackers to execute arbitrary code in a privileged context.

item.title: CVE-2006-1547 — Apache Struts 1
item.description: Threat Signal 66. ActionForm in Apache Struts versions before 1.2.9 with BeanUtils 1.7 contains a vulnerability that allows for denial-of-service (DoS).

item.title: CVE-2021-27860 — FatPipe WARP, IPVPN, and MPVPN software
item.description: Threat Signal 66. A vulnerability in the web management interface of FatPipe WARP, IPVPN, and MPVPN software allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to upload a file to any location on the filesystem.

item.title: CVE-2021-43890 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Microsoft Windows AppX Installer contains a spoofing vulnerability which has a high impacts to confidentiality, integrity, and availability.

item.title: CVE-2019-13272 — Linux Kernel
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Kernel/ptrace.c in Linux kernel mishandles contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that allows local users to obtain root access.

item.title: CVE-2019-15752 — Docker Desktop Community Edition
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Docker Desktop Community Edition contains a vulnerability that may allow local users to escalate privileges by placing a trojan horse docker-credential-wincred.exe file in %PROGRAMDATA%\DockerDesktop\version-bin\.

item.title: CVE-2021-30633 — Google Chromium Indexed DB API
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Google Chromium Indexed DB API contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows a remote attacker, who has compromised the renderer process, to potentially perform a sandbox escape via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2021-38003 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Google Chromium V8 Engine has a bug in JSON.stringify, where the internal TheHole value can leak to script code, causing memory corruption. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.
